messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a recurring pattern where ETL lag spikes correlate with missing spans in the traces index and an aggregation job that emits NaNs. Happened twice this week. Thinking we should sketch a short repair playbook and assign owners.
ashwin: ugh, saw the same. root cause looks like edge-case in the windowing step where late-arriving spans drop the group_by buckets.
ashwin: minimal repro: when span.timestamp < job.watermark AND span.trace_id null -> we drop, which later screws aggregation counts.
sre-bot: incident_alert: observability_etl_high_lag detected at 2024-07-20T09:04:12Z — lag=18m, dropping_rate=0.7% :warning:
zoe: Can we get a quick checklist: 1) stop-gap to reduce drops, 2) backfill missing spans, 3) fix logic so late spans route to overflow bucket, 4) add metric/sla.
dan: I can own the backfill. quick query to get affected traces: ```sql
SELECT trace_id, count(*) as span_count
FROM spans_staging
WHERE ingestion_time BETWEEN now() - interval '48 hours' AND now()
  AND (trace_id IS NULL OR span_timestamp < watermark_ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY span_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
maria: timeline proposal: immediate (0-2h) — patch ETL to route late spans to overflow bucket (ashwin). short (2-12h) — run backfill (dan). medium (24-72h) — merge permanent fix + tests + runbook (zoe). long (week) — add regression alert + dashboards.
ashwin: I can push the overflow routing change as a hotfix. will add a feature-flag. patch PR on my queue, ETA 1.5h.
zoe: I'll write the runbook section for "late spans and aggregation skew" and add the new metric (dropped_spans_rate). will also add a dashboard panel showing aggregation deltas pre/post backfill.
dan: Backfill plan: incremental idempotent job, mark touched traces. I'll post the job proto in #eng-sre after I draft. ETA to start 3h from now, expected run ~4-6h depending on volume.
maria: owners: ashwin=hotfix+merge, dan=backfill, zoe=runbook+dashboards, maria=postmortem summary + verify product metrics. I'll log these as action items in the postmortem doc.
ashwin: quick note — adding overflow bucket will slightly change downstream cardinality. will notify analytics to expect a small delta.
zoe: also recommend adding a weekly check that compares aggregator output vs raw counts for anomalies >1%. schedule as a cron job+alert.
dan: If anyone needs the backfill SQL skeleton: ```sql
INSERT INTO spans_canonical (trace_id, ...)
SELECT coalesce(trace_id, gen_uuid()) as trace_id, ...
FROM spans_staging
WHERE <conditions indicating dropped>
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
```
maria: thanks all. next check-in in 6 hours or sooner if hotfix merges. :thumbsup:
